templates.question: Will episode {episode_id} enter an evidenced ceasefire state by {horizon}?
templates.outcome_rule: yes if a supported ceasefire claim is recorded before horizon and no earlier qualifying collapse supersedes it

templates.question: Will episode {episode_id} generate a supported conflict event in an additional sovereign country by {horizon}?
templates.outcome_rule: yes if a research-coded or corroborated event meeting the country-expansion rule is observed before horizon

templates.question: Will a named strategic port linked to episode {episode_id} suffer an evidenced operational disruption by {horizon}?
templates.outcome_rule: yes only when a supported disruption claim is linked to a resolved port entity

templates.question: Will a named chokepoint linked to episode {episode_id} receive an official or independently corroborated material navigation restriction by {horizon}?
templates.outcome_rule: yes when official maritime warning/restriction or independently corroborated evidence meets policy threshold

templates.question: Will a specified authority impose a new relevant sanctions designation or measure linked to episode {episode_id} by {horizon}?
templates.outcome_rule: yes only from the issuing authority's official record

templates.question: Will episode {episode_id} be in escalating state at {horizon}?
templates.outcome_rule: yes according to the versioned deterministic episode-state method frozen at forecast creation

templates.question: Will episode {episode_id} be in deescalating or ceasefire state at {horizon}?
templates.outcome_rule: yes according to the versioned deterministic episode-state method frozen at forecast creation
